info.title: attest
info.description: The Attest.NET dotnet tool: `attest --diff` proposes and refutes property-based tests for your diff, `attest init` scaffolds attest.json, `attest doctor` checks the environment before anything costs money.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check the environment (git, dotnet, Stryker, provider config).

options.name: --trace-id
options.description: Pass-through requirement/ticket tag on every delivered property.

options.name: --export-evidence
options.description:
Write the report as evidence: <path> (compact JSON) plus
<path>.sha256 (a SHA-256 digest, or HMAC-SHA256 keyed by the
ATTEST_EVIDENCE_KEY environment variable if it is set).

options.name: --max-llm-cost
options.description:
Refuse to deliver a report whose LLM call cost more than this
(USD). The call itself already happened; this does not prevent
spending, it stops an over-budget result from being delivered.
